entries.canonicalText: given a write completes and the process is killed unexpectedly, when the process restarts and the data is read back, then the write is present and identical to what was written.
entries.given: a write completes and the process is killed unexpectedly
entries.when: the process restarts and the data is read back
entries.then: the write is present and identical to what was written

entries.canonicalText: given the storage schema evolves across versions, when the app starts against an older schema, then the app either applies a documented migration and starts, or refuses to start with a clear error naming the schema version mismatch. Silent schema drift is the failure mode this AC exists to prevent.
entries.given: the storage schema evolves across versions
entries.when: the app starts against an older schema
entries.then: the app either applies a documented migration and starts, or refuses to start with a clear error naming the schema version mismatch
entries.notes: Silent schema drift is the failure mode this AC exists to prevent.

entries.canonicalText: given a REQ that mentions backups or retention, when a backup runs, then the backup produces an observable artefact (a file, a log entry, a metrics counter) that a monitoring surface can read. Opt out where backups are entirely out of scope for the REQ.
entries.given: a REQ that mentions backups or retention
entries.then: the backup produces an observable artefact (a file, a log entry, a metrics counter) that a monitoring surface can read
entries.notes: Opt out where backups are entirely out of scope for the REQ.
